title: Coefficient quotient map and induced quotient isomorphism
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, r i natural numbers with 1 ≤ r and i ≤ r, and g : Fin i → R. There exist an R-linear coefficient quotient map from MvPolynomial (Fin r) R to the direct sum of the quotients by the ideals generated by the g indices occurring in each monomial, together with its coefficient formula, surjectivity, kernel equal to the coordinate ideal, and an R-linear isomorphism from the quotient by that coordinate ideal to the direct sum, commuting with the quotient map.

proof.text: Construct the coefficientwise quotient map into the direct sum; finite support gives a well-defined linear map and monomials give surjectivity.

Identify its kernel with the coordinate ideal using the coefficient membership criterion, then apply the first isomorphism theorem for modules to obtain the quotient equivalence and its commutation formula.

lean.statement: theorem ideal_coefficients_monomial_map {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (r i : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hir : i ≤ r) (g : Fin i → R) : ∃ Φ : MvPolynomial (Fin r) R →ₗ[R] Π₀ E : Fin r →₀ ℕ, R ⧸ Ideal.span (g '' {j : Fin i | E (Fin.castLE hir j) ≠ 0}), (∀ q E, Φ q E = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (coeff E q)) ∧ Function.Surjective Φ ∧ LinearMap.ker Φ = Submodule.restrictScalars R (Ideal.span (Set.range fun j : Fin i => C (g j) * X (Fin.castLE hir j))) ∧ ∃ e : (MvPolynomial (Fin r) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range fun j : Fin i => C (g j) * X (Fin.castLE hir j))) ≃ₗ[R] Π₀ E : Fin r →₀ ℕ, R ⧸ Ideal.span (g '' {j : Fin i | E (Fin.castLE hir j) ≠ 0}), ∀ q, e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ q) = Φ q
